title: Safer defaults for text generation
summary:
Text requests got safer token defaults and shorter queue spacing, while image feeds and model routing received a tune-up.

Requests that omit `max_tokens` now get model-specific defaults for Llamaguard and Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, helping prevent Llamaguard context-window errors. Explicit token limits are unchanged.

Text requests from the same IP are now spaced 6 seconds apart instead of 12. Image feed handling also filters private events for non-NSFW listeners and treats `private=true` as `nofeed`.

Claude 3.5 Haiku and Hormoz 8B now use the Portkey gateway. Claude handler errors now return a chat completion marked `donation_request: true`, while the web search tool defaults to 3 results and accepts 1–7.
